technique_name: Describe a system capable of detecting hate speech in tweets.
description: A system for detecting hate speech in tweets should first employ a technique for preprocessing the tweets, including tokenizing, token-level normalization (e.g. stemming and lemmatization), and removing stop words. Once the tweets are preprocessed, they can be distributed into clusters based on lexical similarity.
